build_motion_module: build a MotionModule instance from a Motion object to compute bone transforms and velocities over time
create_motion_series: create a MotionModule.Series with bone names, transforms, and velocities for a given time range
compute_smoothed_transforms: compute smoothed bone transformations using Gaussian filtering over a time window with MotionModule.GetTransforms
draw_motion_series: draw bone positions, velocities, and skeleton connections from a MotionModule.Series using the Draw method
get_bone_velocities: get bone velocities at given timestamps with optional Gaussian smoothing via MotionModule.GetVelocities
